titleSq: Tokë në shitje në Henc, Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Land for sale in Henc, Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq: Ofrohet per shitje truall me siperfaqe 37.28 ari, me lokacion ne Henc, Fushe Kosove.
Trualli ka infrastrukture te plote, qasje ne rruge, ujesjelles, kanalizim, si dhe lidhje me energji elektrike.
I pajisur me flete poseduese dhe kontrata behet tek noteri.
Trualli ndodhet ne nje zone te qete rezidenciale, ideale per ndertim te ulet per jetese.
descriptionEn: Land for sale with an area of 37.28 ares, located in Henc, Fushë Kosovë.
The land has full infrastructure: road access, water supply, sewage, as well as an electricity connection.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The land is located in a quiet residential area, ideal for low-rise residential construction.
